reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Hospital Inclusive Charges Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Routine inpatient and outpatient facility services are included in room, board, facility, or surgical room charges and are not separately reimbursed. For facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management, reimbursement is limited to one unit per day, while routine tracheostomy and respiratory-care components remain bundled.

pairing_conditions: as part of room and board

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Bundle facility-service codes 99190-99192, A4481, A4605, A4623-A4629, and A7501-A7527 on facility claims, while preserving the exception that "PICC line insertions may be separately reimbursed." Exempt: PICC line insertions may be separately reimbursed. Peer: United Health treats revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-309, 361, 391, 410, and 412 as inclusive facility charges and limits them to 1 unit per day on UB04 facility claims..

IA — Implement a UB04 facility-claim edit that treats revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-309, 361, 391, 410, and 412 as inclusive when billed "as part of room and board" or "as part of facility charge", and limit payment to 1 unit per day on inpatient and outpatient facility claims. Cigna bundles 99190-99192, A4481, A4605, A4623-A4629, and A7501-A7527 in facility services, with a separate respiratory-services cap of 24 units per day..
